description.en: Obtains a "topic" item with the standard "J_08" jingle and "system-topic-get" message presentation — a fixed-preset wrapper around RunGetItemEx.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Obtain a topic item derived from a bit index
RunGetWadai(format("int%04d", itemBit % 1600));
